==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this skill once combat has been entered; they will attempt to maintain it for the duration of combat.

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Recovery]].
* Recovery will reduce the duration of burning on spirits, including itself.
{{Bug|The French translation of [[Spirit of Recovery]] is the same as [[Spirit of Recuperation]] but with a lower case "r", which can be misleading.}}
{{anomaly|Rather than conditions expiring at a faster rate, their duration is reduced by the stated percentage.}}

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
